summary: Pure integer ID-to-value lookup table. Takes an index a1 and returns a constant via a switch dispatch: 0 -> 100, {1,3,4,5,6,9,10,11,12,14,15,16,18,20,21,22,23,24} -> 50, {2,13} -> 49, {7,8,19} -> 51, 17 -> 52, and 0 for any other value. Uses a jump table at 0x004D921C for dispatch and has no side effects.

operations.description: Initialize result to 0 before the switch dispatch.
Switch dispatch on a1 via the read-only jump table at 0x004D921C; any value not handled by a case falls through to default.
Case 0 maps the ID to value 100.
Cases {2,13} map the ID to value 49.
Cases {7,8,19} map the ID to value 51.
Case 17 maps the ID to value 52.
Return the mapped value; the default path returns the initial value 0.
